title: acrophorus macraeanus
intro: Acrophorus macraeanus, commonly known as Yellow-eyed Daisy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acrophorus macraeanus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its various health benefits and medicinal properties.
